text: Dallah Healthcare Company acquired Al Ahsa Hospital in Al Ahsa and renamed it Dallah Al Ahsa Hospital; Dallah Hospitals is Dallah Healthcare's hospital group.

source.name: Dallah Hospital – Dallah Hospitals expand to the Eastern Province
source.quote: Dallah Hospitals expand to the Eastern Province following Dallah Healthcare’s acquisition of Al Salam Hospital in Khobar and Al Ahsa Hospital in Al Ahsa
source.note: Announcement on the Dallah Hospitals website, dated 24 March 2025 on the page; it goes on to say the hospitals are 'now renamed: Dallah Khobar Hospital, Dallah Al Ahsa Hospital'. Al-Fateh's partner is listed as 'مستشفيات دله الأحساء' (Dallah Hospitals Al-Ahsa) on the club's partners page.

additionalSources.name: Dallah Health – 500 Million SAR Expected Increase in Dallah Healthcare's Revenues … Acquisition of Al Salam and Al Ahsa Hospitals
additionalSources.quote: the completion of its acquisition of Ayan Investment Company’s shares in Al Ahsa and Al Salam Hospitals in the Eastern Province
additionalSources.note: Dallah Healthcare press release; it says the company acquired 97.41% of Al Ahsa Medical Services Company (Al Ahsa Hospital). The page is undated; the date is the day it was opened.
